limitations: Known 35-chip screening split, 144 fit events; not independent confirmation.
Only two training seeds; large observed seed spread means .005 alone is not evidence of significance.
Raw seed effects have opposite signs (-.015968,+.008111); mean delta -.003929 does not meet +.005.
Fixed v13+two optical controls improves the known split; it is not a proven held-out improvement and no best seed was selected.
non_claims: Does not prove all raw-band architectures are worse.
Does not establish closed-test or CEMS superiority.
Siamese numerical failures are recorded separately, not counted as accuracy failures.
